candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle connections and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order POST 503s and gateway checkout 502s after ~2s.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side pool metrics or DB logs; pool saturation inferred from span attributes only.

report.explanation: Traces show postgres.save_order failing with DependencyUnavailable while pool size=5 and idle=0 across all sampled checkouts; order returns 503 and gateway checkout returns 502 at ~2s. Inventory and payment succeed, so the fault is bounded to the order-to-postgres path. Pool exhaustion is the best-supported taxonomy cause.
